description: John 3:16 "told back" with a story about buying bread: no point is caught, all of them are missed, and the question sends him back to the first point kindly.

request.passage: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
request.narration: A man went to the market and bought some bread and then he went home.
